dct_description_sm: This airborne or shipborne geophysical survey recorded the following parameters: Total Field Magnetic. The flight line spacing is 805 m. The survey was flown between 1968-08-01 and 1969-10-31. The data were Digitized from contour maps. Platform: Fixed-wing.

Le levé a été effectué pendant la période allant de 1968-08-01 et 1969-10-31. Les données furent Numérisées à partir des cartes de contours. Plat-forme : Avion.
